title: Shoe Size Converter
description: Convert shoe sizes between US, UK and EU systems, with foot length in centimeters.
howto: Enter your US shoe size (halves allowed).
Read your UK, EU and foot-length equivalents.

faqs.q: How do men's and women's US sizes relate?
faqs.a: Women's US sizes run 1.5 larger than men's for the same foot: a women's 9.5 ≈ a men's 8.

faqs.q: What is the UK to US difference?
faqs.a: UK sizes are 0.5 below US men's sizes: US 9 men ≈ UK 8.5.

faqs.q: Is foot length the most reliable measure?
faqs.a: Yes. Measure your foot in cm and match it — it is brand-independent, unlike numbered sizes.
